label: Peplink MAX Transit Duo (LTE-A CAT-6, worldwide)
description: Transportation router with two LTE-A CAT-6 modems: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Transit Duo datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **1 / 0 (GE)**, LAN port **1 / 2 (GE)**, Router Throughput 400 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes. **CAT-6 here, CAT-12 on the other LTE-A Duo in this catalogue** - the same ports and the same 400 Mbps ceiling, with the difference living entirely in the modem's cellular capability, which the port list cannot show.
